name: Gild
author: Erin Carter
description: Interlocking metal rings turning slowly on three axes — raymarched gold tori with mirror reflections of a palette-tinted studio, crisp speculars and grazing fresnel. A premium polished-metal object filling the frame.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation speed of the rings on their separate axes; 0 holds them still.

params.label: Tube
params.effect: Thickness of the ring tubes; low gives slender wire rings, high fat bands.

params.label: Polish
params.effect: Mirror finish — sharpness and brightness of the speculars, from satin to high-gloss.

params.label: Tint
params.effect: How strongly the metal takes the palette colour; low is near-neutral chrome, high is saturated gold/colour.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera; 0 ignores the mouse.
